## 简体中文

- 系统路由表支持跨页排序，排序依据完整数据而非仅当前页。
- 首次自动启动、手动启动和重启统一记录核心启动过程，均可从重启按钮右侧查看启动日志；弹窗按实际动作显示状态。
- 修复从顶栏启动日志打开“查看完整配置”时，代码块缺少 ToastProvider 导致整个页面白屏的问题；保留原有页面样式作用范围。
- 已通过本地静态检查、现有前端相关测试和 Rust 工作区测试；部署后的浏览器及真实核心启动验收仍需验证。

## English

- Sort the system routing table across all pages using the complete data set.
- Record automatic startup, manual startup, and restart through a shared core startup log, available beside the restart button with action-specific status messages.
- Fix a blank page when opening the full configuration from the header startup log by sharing component providers across the shell while preserving the existing style scope.
- Local static checks, existing affected frontend tests, and Rust workspace tests passed; deployed browser and real-core startup acceptance remain to be verified.
